title: MCP server configuration (.mcp.json)
description: Schema for <cwd..git-root>/.mcp.json, plugin .mcp.json files, and the mcpServers object embedded in ~/.claude.json and .cursor/mcp.json. Root type McpConfig has exactly one recognized field, "mcpServers" (serde rename of mcp_servers); any other top-level key is ignored by the loader and is therefore unconstrained here [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:478-482]. Each entry under mcpServers is a McpServerConfig: the transport (Stdio or StreamableHttp) is #[serde(flatten)] over an untagged enum, so transport-specific and server-level keys live in the same JSON object [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:34-67,166-189]. Server sources are merged in order: config.toml seeds the map (enabled=false blocks lower layers) -> plugins (or_insert) -> ~/.claude.json (or_insert) -> .mcp.json (or_insert, team baseline) -> client override (insert, always wins) -> managed header injection [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/session/managed_mcp.rs:5-16]. Because the transport enum is untagged and no struct in the chain sets deny_unknown_fields, an object containing both "command" and "url" deserializes successfully as Stdio (the first variant tried; the extra "url" key is simply ignored) -- this schema accepts such documents too, matching that behavior exactly [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:34-46].

mcpServers.description: Map of server name to server config; serde rename of mcp_servers (an IndexMap at runtime, preserving insertion order; immaterial to JSON Schema validation) [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:478-482].

stdioTransport.description: Stdio transport variant of the untagged McpServerTransportConfig; matches when "command" is present as a JSON string [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:36-46].

command.description: Executable to launch; the only field on this variant with no serde default, so its presence (as a string) is what makes an object match Stdio under untagged first-match resolution [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:38].

args.description: Command-line arguments; defaults to an empty array [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:39-40].

env.description: Extra environment variables for the spawned process; explicit null is accepted via standard Option<HashMap> deserialization [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:41-42].

cwd.description: Working directory for the spawned process. Present in the on-disk MCP JSON format, but not yet forwarded to the ACP stdio server config [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:43-45].

streamableHttpTransport.description: StreamableHttp transport variant of the untagged McpServerTransportConfig; every field has a serde default, so this variant matches virtually any object once Stdio's required "command" is absent -- and an object can still match this variant even while carrying an ill-typed "command" key, since that key is simply an unrecognized/ignored extra property here [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:47-66].

url.description: Canonical key for the endpoint URL; defaults to "" if absent, in which case to_acp_mcp_server treats the server as absent [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:48-49,372-375].

urlTemplate.description: Accepted serde alias for "url"; "url" is canonical [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:48].

url_template.description: Accepted serde alias for "url"; "url" is canonical [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:48].

type.description: Transport hint; "sse" (case-insensitive) selects the SSE client, as does a url ending in "/sse" regardless of this field's value. No other values are validated by serde -- any string is accepted [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:50-51,404-407].

bearer_token_env_var.description: Name of the env var read for an "Authorization: Bearer <token>" header [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:52-54].

oauth_client_id.description: OAuth client ID for providers without Dynamic Client Registration [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:57-59].

oauth_client_secret_env_var.description: Name of the env var holding the OAuth client secret [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:60-62].

oauth_scopes.description: OAuth scopes to request during authorization [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:63-65].

mcpJsonOAuthBlock.description: OAuth block for a server's top-level "oauth" field; camelCase on the wire [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:69-80].

clientSecretEnvVar.description: Env var name holding the OAuth client secret [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:74-75].

mcpSetupConfig.description: Setup-flow schema for servers requiring user input before the transport is usable; v0 supports exactly one select field [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:82-88,255-305].

fields.description: Setup fields; the resolver currently requires exactly one field of type "select" [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:84-85,262-272].

variables.description: Derived values keyed by name, substituted into {{name}} templates once setup resolves [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:86-87,191-250].

values.description: Accepted serde alias for "variables"; "variables" is canonical [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:86].

type.description: Field kind; "select" is the only McpSetupFieldType variant today (rename_all = lowercase) [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:94-95,104-108].

required.description: Whether the user must supply a value [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:96-97].

mcpSetupOption.description: One selectable option in a setup field [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:110-114].

value.description: Option value, matched against user input and mcpSetupDerivedValue.map keys [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:113].

mcpSetupDerivedValue.description: A value derived from a setup field's selected option [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:116-120].

from.description: References a field id declared in the same setup block [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:118].

mcpServerEntry.description: One value under mcpServers: McpServerConfig, the flatten of the untagged transport (see stdioTransport/streamableHttpTransport) plus server-level fields declared below [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:166-189].

enabled.description: Whether this server is active; defaults to true. config.toml layer setting this to false blocks lower merge layers from re-enabling the server [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:13-15,170-171].

oauth.description: Server-level OAuth block; also settable via the StreamableHttp transport's oauth_client_id/oauth_client_secret_env_var/oauth_scopes fields, which take precedence when both are set [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:172-173,422-452].

setup.description: Setup-flow schema gating this server until resolved [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:174-175].

startup_timeout_sec.description: Seconds to wait for the server to start [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:176-177].

tool_timeouts.description: Per-tool timeout overrides in seconds, keyed by tool name; falls back to tool_timeout_sec for tools not listed [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:180-183].

expose_image_base64.description: Also keep raw base64 in tool-result text so agents can forward image bytes via path-based tools; overridden per-call by _meta.mcpConfig.<server>.exposeImageBase64 [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/mcp.rs:184-188].
